company.name: ZoNuLy
company.description: Referral pipeline for Tejmul — Bengaluru + Hyderabad fresher roles, proved addresses only, sending gated.

project.name: ZoNuLy pipeline
project.description: The jobhunter/ pipeline and dashboard/. Engineers work in isolated git worktrees branched from main; Tejmul merges.

permissions_note: No --dangerously-skip-permissions anywhere. `default` = read + allowlisted Bash only (headless Claude Code refuses edits); `acceptEdits` = may also edit inside its cwd (the worktree). Bash runs only if .claude/settings.json allows it.

agents.name: CEO
agents.title: Owns the motive; sets ≤3 weekly goals; briefs Tejmul
agents.capabilities: Reads BRIEF and the numbers; files GOAL issues for the CTO; writes the CEO brief. No code, no merges, no spending.

agents.name: CTO
agents.title: Technical architecture; turns evidence into TECH issues
agents.capabilities: Reads autoreview / tick / reacher logs; files ≤4 TECH issues per run with acceptance tests for the Manager; answers ?CTO questions. No code.

agents.name: Manager
agents.title: Assigns, chases, gates to the Reviewer
agents.capabilities: Routes TECH/OPS issues to the right engineer, one in progress each; chases stale work; sends done work to the Reviewer; marks READY FOR TEJMUL. No code.

agents.name: Scraper engineer
agents.title: scrapers/, tick.py, sources — the stall problem
agents.capabilities: Fixes one scraping/tick issue per run in an isolated worktree; pytest; commits on a branch; never pushes or merges.

agents.name: Leads engineer
agents.title: contacts/, proving, segregation — proved addresses only
agents.capabilities: Fixes one contacts/proving/leak issue per run in an isolated worktree; pytest + tsc; commits on a branch; never pushes or merges.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.title: Rules, then honesty, then correctness
agents.capabilities: Reviews an engineer branch: hard rules first, then the honesty of the report, then correctness. APPROVE / CHANGES / REJECT. Never merges.

agents.name: DevOps
agents.title: Watches launchd, the tick log, locks, proving rate
agents.capabilities: Every 3h: launchctl list, tail tick-free.log, locks, reacher rate; files OPS issues with evidence; may kickstart com.zonuly.tick.free only. Never runs stages, never touches the DB.

routines.title: CEO — weekly goals and brief
routines.description: Weekly: read BRIEF.md and the numbers, set ≤3 measurable GOAL issues for the CTO, comment on last week's goals, write the CEO brief for Tejmul. See CEO.md.

routines.title: CTO — read the loop, file TECH issues
routines.description: Daily: autoreview.log rejections by cause, tick-free.log stall signatures, reacher-audit.log rate; ≤4 TECH issues with acceptance tests, assigned to the Manager. See CTO.md.

routines.title: Manager — assign, chase, gate
routines.description: Every 2 hours in the day: route open TECH/OPS issues to engineers (one in progress each), chase stale work with --resume, send finished work to the Reviewer, mark READY FOR TEJMUL. See MANAGER.md.

routines.title: DevOps — is the pipeline running and moving
routines.description: Every 3 hours: launchctl list, tick-free.log freshness and stall counts, stale locks, reacher rate. OPS issues with evidence to the Manager; kickstart tick.free only if loaded but dead. See DEVOPS.md.
